# Joshua Darron Phillips, Full Profile

> Founding engineer at RocketRide, an open-source AI runtime. I build the developer-facing surface in TypeScript, Python, and C++.

## About

Joshua Darron Phillips is a founding-team engineer at RocketRide AI Inc., based in California. He owns the developer-facing surface of an open-source MIT-licensed AI runtime: the TypeScript and Python SDKs, the MCP server, the VS Code extension, and the workshop tooling.

He also built Pulsar, a market intelligence agent running internally across finance, HR, and marketing at RocketRide, which launches as a featured app on RocketRide Cloud. He works in TypeScript, Python, and C++, and writes about what he builds. Two of his recent pieces have been published in Level Up Coding.

## Skills & Technologies

- Languages: TypeScript, Python, C++, JavaScript, Go
- Backend: Node.js, REST APIs, Data Streaming, Pipeline Architecture
- AI Tooling: MCP servers, AI Agents, AI Runtimes, OpenAI, Claude, Ollama
- Databases: Postgres, Neo4j (Graph Data Science), MySQL, MongoDB, MSSQL, ArangoDB
- Frontend: Next.js, React, Vue.js
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Docker, Linux
- Other: Salesforce, Agile/Scrum, Vim

## Experience

### RocketRide AI Inc., Founding Engineer (2026 - Present)
Location: San Francisco, CA

Founding-team engineer on an open-source MIT-licensed AI runtime. Owns the developer-facing surface: TypeScript SDK, Python SDK, MCP server, VS Code extension, and workshop tooling. Built Pulsar, a market intelligence agent running internally across finance, HR, and marketing at RocketRide, which launches as a featured app on RocketRide Cloud.

Key Highlights:
- Built and published the RocketRide TypeScript and Python SDKs on npm and PyPI
- Developed the RocketRide MCP stdio server for streaming local files to the runtime
- Built the RocketRide VS Code extension for in-IDE pipeline development
- Designed the workshop launchpad: cross-platform tool that resolves runtime versions, downloads OS-specific binaries, and boots UI plus API plus runtime with one pnpm dev
- Built Pulsar end-to-end (Next.js, Postgres, Neo4j with Graph Data Science, Claude Sonnet, RocketRide pipelines), adopted internally across finance, HR, and marketing
- Contributed to the open source RocketRide server and authored the official platform documentation

Technologies: TypeScript, Python, C++, Node.js, MCP, Postgres, Neo4j, Docker, REST API

### Aparavi Software AG, Software Engineer (2022 - 2026)
Location: Santa Monica, CA

Led major initiatives to design and ship new features for the data intelligence automation platform using Node.js, SQL databases, and React.js. Worked closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to ensure features met customer needs. Helped improve team process and workflow by identifying bottlenecks and proposing solutions to increase efficiency. Contributed to the development of data management and protection solutions helping organizations worldwide optimize and safeguard their data.

Key Highlights:
- Designed and implemented new platform features end-to-end across the full stack
- Collaborated cross-functionally with product, design, and engineering to deliver customer-driven features
- Identified process improvements and proposed workflow changes to increase team productivity
- Managed tasks independently using Agile methodologies, delivering on time and within scope
- Built solutions for data classification, protection, and compliance at enterprise scale

Technologies: Node.js, React, SQL, AWS, TypeScript, Agile

Projects:
- Aparavi: Data intelligence automation platform (Node, React, SQL, AWS), https://www.aparavi.com/

## Featured Projects

### Pulsar
Market intelligence agent built on RocketRide. Scrapes eight developer sources twice daily, runs them through pipelines for analysis, produces a trend report and content drafts across seven platforms. Adopted internally at RocketRide by finance, HR, and marketing. Launching as a featured app on RocketRide Cloud.
Stack: Next.js 15, Postgres, Neo4j with Graph Data Science (Louvain community detection, PageRank), Claude Sonnet, RocketRide pipelines.
URL: https://github.com/joshuadarron/pulsar

### RocketRide
Open-source MIT-licensed AI runtime. C++ core with Python and TypeScript SDKs. 2k+ stars on the org repo.
URL: https://github.com/rocketride-org/rocketride-server

### RocketRide Workshops
Hands-on workshop scaffolding for the runtime. Cross-platform launchpad tool resolves runtime versions, downloads OS-specific binaries, and boots UI plus API plus runtime with one pnpm dev.
URL: https://github.com/rocketride-org/rocketride-workshops

### rocket-reviewer
Multi-agent code review system.
URL: https://github.com/joshuadarron/rocket-reviewer

### godseye
Real-time global tracking system.
URL: https://github.com/joshuadarron/godseye
